How do I distinguish vibrato from a bend in a pitch display?

Track pitch over time in cents relative to a reference. Vibrato usually oscillates around a center; a bend changes the center itself, though real playing can combine both. Smooth enough to suppress detector jitter while preserving expressive motion. Test with known synthetic contours before recorded guitar, and report gaps when the detector lacks confidence.

What does the missing fundamental mean?

A listener may perceive a pitch corresponding to a fundamental even when that frequency is absent, because the remaining harmonic spacing supports it. For example, components at 200, 300 and 400 Hz can suggest a 100 Hz fundamental. That does not mean a spectrum must show energy at 100 Hz. Compare a harmonic complex with and without its lowest partial at matched listening level.

Why does zero padding make my spectrum look more precise?

Zero padding samples the finite-window spectrum on a denser grid. It improves interpolation and visual smoothness but does not add observation time or fundamentally separate unresolved tones. Compare a short window with padding against a genuinely longer window containing the same two tones. Distinguish FFT grid spacing from the ability to resolve two nearby frequencies.

How should I preserve filter state across audio blocks?

A causal filter's delay elements must continue from one block into the next. Resetting them for every block creates artificial transients. With second-order sections, retain the returned final state and pass it as the next block's initial state. Compare processing a complete signal against the same signal divided into blocks; apart from a consistent initialization choice, they should agree.

How could I estimate a room's first axial mode?

For an ideal rigid rectangular room, an axial mode along length L has frequency f=c/(2L). If L=5 m and c=343 m/s, that first mode is about 34.3 Hz. Real boundaries, furnishings and damping affect the measured response. Take measurements at several positions because a mode may be strong at one point and weak at another.

What is the difference between a model assumption and measurement uncertainty?

An assumption defines what the model ignores or idealizes; uncertainty describes imperfect knowledge of measured quantities. Treating a drumhead as an ideal membrane is an assumption. A radius measurement of 0.150 m with a stated uncertainty is a measurement issue. Report both, and do not interpret a precise calculation as proof that the simplified model matches the real object.

Why should a model say it needs the board name?

The board determines voltage limits, timers, memory, ADC behavior, DAC availability and pin assignments. Guessing can produce code that fails or a circuit that damages hardware. A useful response can still explain the architecture while asking for the exact board and library version before giving pin-specific wiring.

How do I avoid sharing an API secret in a website chatbot?

Keep the secret in a server-side environment variable and have the browser call your own backend. Never embed it in shipped JavaScript, HTML or a public repository. Restrict and rate-limit the backend so it does not become an unlimited public proxy. Test the static bundle to confirm it contains only a public endpoint, not credentials.

What should a chatbot do if its model server is unavailable?

Show a clear failure message and preserve the visitor's question so they can retry. If there is a local reference mode, label the switch explicitly rather than silently pretending it is the model. Set a timeout, avoid retry storms and restore the input controls after failure. Make status understandable without exposing private server logs.

What is aliasing in a moving graphic?

Sampling a fast spatial or temporal pattern can make it appear as a different pattern: thin lines shimmer and spinning spokes can seem to reverse. More samples, suitable prefiltering and gentler frequency content can help. Increasing frame rate addresses temporal sampling, while antialiasing addresses spatial sampling; neither automatically solves both.

How would you connect an FFT spectrum to particle motion?

Divide the spectrum into frequency bands, calculate a stable energy measure per band and smooth it. Map those energies to bounded forces or emission rates, rather than directly replacing particle positions. Use logarithmic bands if you want more perceptually balanced spacing. Compare with a synthetic tone sweep before a full song to verify the mapping.

How can I reduce double triggers on an electronic drum?

Inspect the sensor envelope after a strike. One physical hit can ring and cross a threshold several times. Combine a threshold with hysteresis and a short retrigger lockout, then tune against real fast playing so you do not suppress intentional rolls. Test misses and double hits separately across a range of velocities.

Why doesn't a drum have one perfectly stable pitch?

Several inharmonic modes can contribute at once, their decays differ, and the effective tension can vary during a strong strike. The perceived pitch may therefore change across the attack and sustain. Report the analysis window and which spectral peak or pitch estimate you tracked. Avoid treating the loudest FFT bin as the drum's single true pitch.

How can I build a simple FM synth on a microcontroller?

Use a carrier oscillator whose phase is modulated by a second oscillator: x[n]=sin(phase_c[n]+I*sin(phase_m[n])). Choose the sample rate and frequency ranges to control aliasing, then keep the audio callback lightweight. Begin with fixed carrier and modulator frequencies before adding knobs or envelopes. Board and library choices determine the exact implementation.

Why does changing the display refresh disrupt my Arduino synth?

The display update may block or compete for CPU time, interrupts or shared buses. Audio still needs a consistent sample schedule. Measure timing, reduce display work and move it outside the audio-critical path. Do not disable interrupts for a long display transfer and expect an interrupt-driven oscillator to remain stable.
